scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Development Of Buddhist/Tibetan Arts And Culture
other_conditions: The organization must be registered as a Society under the Societies Registration Act (XXI of 1860) or a similar Act
It must be a voluntary institution/organization or society devoted primarily to Buddhist/Tibetan studies
It must have been functioning for at least three years
It should be of regional or all‑India character
It must not be receiving grants from any other source for similar purposes
Applications where a previous grant/utilisation certificate is pending will not be considered
Grants are ad‑hoc and non‑recurring; preference is given to organizations that can meet matching funds
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹30 lakh per year for activities such as maintenance, research projects, scholarships, infrastructure development and heritage restoration related to Buddhist/Tibetan arts and culture.
documents_required: Unique ID of NITI Aayog (NGO Darpan)
Detailed break‑up of expenditure under Maintenance (annexure)
